name: caltrain
description: Caltrain (San Francisco Peninsula commuter rail): real-time departures per station, GTFS-realtime trip updates and vehicle positions, service alerts, routes, station pages and site search as JSON commands.

commands.name: get-station-departures
commands.summary: Real-time departure predictions for one Caltrain station, with metadata for the routes serving it (Local, Limited, Express, South County).

params.name: stopId
params.description: Station stop id in lowercase snake_case, e.g. san_francisco, palo_alto, sj_diridon. This is not the same as the station page slug.

commands.name: list-service-alerts
commands.summary: Current Caltrain service alerts: delays, disruptions and notices, with their active periods.
commands.sample: {"Id":9582,"Alert.HeaderText.Translation.0.Text":"","Alert.DescriptionText.Translation.0.Text":"Pets allowed on Caltrain in an enclosed carrier. More info: caltrain.com/code. ","Alert.ActivePeriod":[{"Start":1792410120}],"Alert.InformedEntity":[{"AgencyId":"CT"}],"Source":"PADS"}

commands.name: get-trip-updates
commands.summary: GTFS-realtime trip updates for trains currently running: trip id, route, direction and predicted arrival/departure per stop.

commands.name: list-routes
commands.summary: All Caltrain routes/service types (Local Weekday, Limited, Express, South County…) with route id, color and path.

commands.name: get-station
commands.summary: Station detail page (address, parking, amenities, zone) by station slug.

params.name: slug
params.description: Station page slug with no separators, e.g. paloalto, sanfrancisco, sjdiridon

notes: Two id styles: departures use snake_case stop ids (palo_alto); station pages use slugs with no separators (paloalto).
GTFS-realtime timestamps are Unix seconds; StopId values are GTFS platform ids (e.g. 70262).
Trip planning on the site redirects to Google Maps and is not available here.
